ValidationRule.description: IM-76: Parent must be set on Foundation Codes where the type is not initiative root.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Focus Area'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Non Initiative'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Parent Initiative'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Budgeted Initiative'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Breakout'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Non Programmatic Initiative') ), ISBLANK( Parent__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please set the parent for the Foundation Code.
